description: Recent trades opened through TradeHub with entry, stop, take-profit, leverage and realised profit or loss. Third-party apps see only the trades they opened; the user's own keys and Telegram see all. Use for reviews and reports. Not for live positions (use get_my_open_positions). Input: limit (1-200), closed_since, before (pages: pass next_before back until it is null). Sizes in the base coin, money in USD. Next: get_my_open_positions.

before.description: Next page: the next_before of the previous answer

closed_since.description: Only trades closed at or after this time (ISO 8601); open trades are left out

name: get_my_trade_history

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

fees_settled.description: True when fees_usd is entirely the amounts actually charged

fees_usd.description: Trading fees for opening and closing it, USD: what the exchange charged where its fill records say, else the estimate

net_pnl.description: pnl minus fees_usd, USD (null while open)

pnl.description: Realised profit or loss before fees, USD (null while open)

reason.description: Why, as the agent that opened it wrote it; present only for your own trades

size.description: Size, in the base coin (e.g. BTC), not USD

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

next_before.description: More trades: pass this as before for the next page; null at the end

title: My trade history
